They descended a long way, and then walked for days through tunnels in complete darkness. They almost ran out of water, and Axel feared they would die in these underground passages, but Professor Lidenbrock was very enthusiastic. Eventually they found a strange underground sea. They had entered the earth through an extinct volcano in Iceland, and returned through an active volcano in Italy!
